battle.name: 黎巴嫩戰爭
battle.theater: 黎巴嫩南部與黎以邊境地帶
battle.brief: 維基戰爭列表所列的二〇〇六年黎巴嫩戰爭，是以色列與黎巴嫩真主黨武裝之間的衝突。戰事包括邊境交火、火箭攻擊與地面進攻；以色列地面部隊進入黎巴嫩南部，Merkava III主戰坦克作為裝甲主力，執行突破、警戒及伴隨火力支援任務。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦三型主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦三型是以色列陸軍的主戰坦克，負責裝甲正面作戰、突破與護衛，並與步兵及支援車輛協同行動。

countries: 2006年7月19日至8月11日，黎巴嫩戰爭的主要交戰者是以色列與真主黨。地面戰集中於黎巴嫩南部藍線以北的邊境地帶、利塔尼河附近，以及貝魯特外圍的固定目標；以軍在7月下旬還對黎巴嫩沿岸實施海上封鎖。黎巴嫩軍與內部安全部隊沒有以主力身份加入對以色列的地面進攻，美國、法國等則提供空中支援、海上護航與外交協調。聯合國觀察力量在停火前後維持有限存在。7月11日安理會第1696號決議要求停止攻擊、撤出黎境並處理兩名被扣以軍士兵；7月19日以色列開始「夏季雨水」行動，7月21日真主黨宣布「真實承諾」行動，8月4日再發動「支援抵抗」攻勢。8月10日第1701號決議通過，8月11日凌晨主要炮火停止。國家、交戰組織、黎巴嫩政府力量與聯合國角色，不能混寫成單一國家戰爭。
countriesEn: From 19 July to 11 August 2006, the main belligerents in the Lebanon War were Israel and Hezbollah. Ground fighting was concentrated in the border belt north of the Blue Line in southern Lebanon, around the Litani River, and against fixed targets on the outskirts of Beirut; Israel also enforced a naval blockade off the Lebanese coast from late July. The Lebanese Armed Forces and Internal Security Forces did not join a major Israeli ground offensive, while the United States, France, and other states provided air support, maritime cover, and diplomatic coordination. United Nations observers maintained a limited presence around the ceasefire. Resolution 1696, adopted on 11 July, called for attacks to stop, a withdrawal, and the return of two detained Israeli soldiers. Israel began Operation Summer Rains on 19 July; Hezbollah announced Operation True Promise on 21 July and launched Operation Supporting the Resistance on 4 August. Resolution 1701 was adopted on 10 August, and the main artillery fire ceased in the early hours of 11 August. The state, armed organization, Lebanese government forces, and United Nations roles must not be merged into a single state-to-state war.
people: 以色列方面的核心決策者是總理埃胡德·奧爾默特，他主持戰時內閣與外交協調；國防部長阿米爾·佩雷茨在7月31日辭職，軍方則由國防軍總參謀長丹·哈魯茨、北部司令部司令班尼·甘茨、地面部隊司令伊斯雷爾·塔爾，以及空軍司令阿莫斯·亞德林共同負責作戰。北部司令部處理黎南戰區，地面部隊處理道路、步兵與裝甲協同，空軍負責制空、偵察和對地打擊。真主黨方面，賽義德·哈桑·納斯魯拉是政治與公開領導人，伊馬德·卡西姆是軍事領導人，奈姆·哈卡拉則屬於前線作戰指揮體系；7月25日，负责軍事事務的高級官員阿布·阿里·穆斯塔法在以軍空襲中死亡。納斯魯拉在戰役中發表講話，維持了真主黨的政治宣傳，但公開資料沒有提供完整、可核驗的全戰區指揮鏈與完整兵力表。
peopleEn: On the Israeli side, Prime Minister Ehud Olmert chaired the wartime cabinet and diplomatic coordination. Defense Minister Amir Peretz resigned on 31 July, while Chief of Staff Dan Halutz, Northern Command commander Benny Gantz, Ground Forces commander Israel Tal, and Air Force commander Amos Yadlin directed military operations. Northern Command handled the southern Lebanon theater, the Ground Forces coordinated infantry and armor movement, and the Air Force handled air superiority, reconnaissance, and strikes. On the Hezbollah side, Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah was the political and public leader, Imad Qassem was a military leader, and Naim Khakhal belonged to the frontline operational command. Abu Ali Mustafa, a senior official responsible for military affairs, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on 25 July. Nasrallah delivered major public statements during the campaign, but the available information does not provide a complete, verifiable theater-wide chain of command or a full verified order of battle.
kits: 以色列在2006年使用的裝備包括F-16I與F-15I戰鬥機、AH-64D攻擊直升機，以及IAI Eitan和RQ-2 Pioneer無人偵察機。地面作戰主要使用Merkava Mk IV主戰坦克、M60A1與M60A3坦克、Namer履帶式裝甲車、Tzukit輪式裝甲車與Achbarit裝甲運兵車；部分Merkava Mk IV配有Trophy主動防護系統。炮兵包括M109A2自走式155公厘榴彈砲、PzH 2000自走式榴彈砲、M270多管火箭系統，以及M252 81公厘迫擊砲。真主黨可使用的重武器包括BM-21卡秋莎122公厘火箭砲、9K51系列無後坐力砲、9K14「女武神」反裝甲飛彈、SPG-9線導反裝甲飛彈與RPG-7系列火箭筒；其地面部隊也使用T-54、T-55與M60系列坦克，以及AK-47、AKM、PKM等輕武器。上述型號在2006年以前均已有服役紀錄，或已在2006年戰役中列裝。
kitsEn: The Israeli equipment used in 2006 included F-16I and F-15I fighters, AH-64D attack helicopters, and IAI Eitan and RQ-2 Pioneer reconnaissance UAVs. Ground operations relied on Merkava Mk IV main battle tanks, M60A1 and M60A3 tanks, Namer tracked armored vehicles, Tzukit wheeled armored vehicles, and Achbarit armored personnel carriers; some Merkava Mk IVs carried the Trophy active-protection system. Artillery included the M109A2 155 mm self-propelled howitzer, PzH 2000 self-propelled howitzer, M270 multiple-rocket launcher, and M252 81 mm mortar. Hezbollah heavy weapons included the BM-21 Katyusha 122 mm rocket launcher, 9K51-series recoilless rifles, 9K14 Valkyrie anti-tank missiles, SPG-9 wire-guided anti-tank missiles, and RPG-7-series launchers. Its forces also used T-54, T-55, and M60-series tanks, together with AK-47, AKM, PKM, and other light weapons. All of these systems had entered service before 2006 or were fielded by 2006.
tactics: 以色列先以空中、海上和炮兵建立火力密度，目標包括邊境反裝甲陣地、火箭發射點、雷達、通信節點與指揮所。7月19日至月底，F-16I與F-15I反覆進入黎境，無人機提供目標校正；固定目標遭擊後，以軍再以AH-64D、M109A2與PzH 2000覆蓋殘存陣地。7月下旬至8月初，地面部隊由步兵、坦克、工兵和工程車協同，從邊境東側、南部丘陵道路及沿海公路幾個方向推進，先清除道路、障礙與可疑陣地，再轉移炮兵和後勤。8月4日，真主黨以步兵、迫擊砲和反裝甲小組打擊以軍在馬龍拉斯及邊境走廊的據點，並向縱深射擊火箭；以軍則用Merkava、Tzukit與裝甲支援車封住道路、射擊通道和撤退線。真主黨把兵力分散在地下室、隧道、反斜面陣地與不同發射點，短時間射擊後轉移器材，避免多個發射器同時暴露。以軍後來把地面部署推向利塔尼河附近，但沒有控制整個黎巴嫩。
tacticsEn: Israel first built firepower density through air, naval, and artillery operations. Targets included border anti-tank positions, rocket launchers, radar, communications nodes, and command posts. From 19 July through the end of the month, F-16I and F-15I aircraft repeatedly entered Lebanese airspace, with UAVs correcting target coordinates. After fixed targets were struck, AH-64D helicopters, M109A2 howitzers, and PzH 2000 howitzers covered surviving positions. From late July into early August, infantry, tanks, engineers, and armored engineering vehicles advanced along several axes, including the eastern border approaches, southern hill roads, and the coastal road. They first cleared roads, obstacles, and suspected positions, then moved artillery and logistics forward. On 4 August, Hezbollah used infantry, mortars, and anti-tank groups against Israeli positions around Maroun al-Ras and the border corridor, while also firing rockets deeper toward the rear. Israel used Merkava, Tzukit, and armored support vehicles to seal roads, firing lanes, and withdrawal routes. Hezbollah dispersed forces through underground positions, tunnels, reverse-slope sites, and separate launcher locations, firing briefly and then relocating equipment so that several launchers would not be exposed at once. Israel later pushed its ground deployment toward the Litani River but did not control all of Lebanon.
data: 可核對的時間節點包括：7月19日以軍開始空襲並進入黎境；7月21日真主黨擴大火箭砲與地面交火；7月25日阿布·阿里·穆斯塔法在空襲中死亡；7月31日至8月1日馬龍拉斯一帶爆發密集地面戰；8月4日真主黨發動攻勢；8月10日聯合國安理會通過第1701號決議；8月11日凌晨停火安排開始生效，正式戰鬥期約三週。以軍在戰役高峰期投入數個旅與師級支援單位，公開資料常以約三萬名部隊作為規模估計；真主黨則以營、連級單位分散作戰，沒有可完整核驗的總兵力名冊。以軍戰後曾公布逾三千枚火箭及迫擊砲彈，其他來源採較低數字，因此較穩妥的說法是發彈量達數以千計。黎南後勤依靠公路縱隊、臨時補給點、前進維修與小型分散運輸；聯合國第1701號決議授權把聯南部隊擴至一萬五千人。各方傷亡統計口徑差異很大，本實錄不把任何單一估算硬寫成確切傷亡總數。
dataEn: The verifiable timetable includes the Israeli air campaign and entry into Lebanon on 19 July; the expansion of Hezbollah rocket and ground fire on 21 July; the death of Abu Ali Mustafa in an airstrike on 25 July; intense fighting around Maroun al-Ras from 31 July to 1 August; the Hezbollah offensive on 4 August; Security Council Resolution 1701 on 10 August; and the ceasefire arrangement taking effect in the early hours of 11 August. The formal combat period lasted about three weeks. At its high point, Israel deployed several brigades with divisional support units in Lebanon; public accounts commonly used an estimate of about 30,000 personnel, while Hezbollah organized its forces into battalion- and company-sized units without a fully verifiable total order of battle. After the war, the Israeli military reported more than 3,000 rockets and mortar rounds launched, while other sources recorded lower figures, so the safer description is that thousands were fired. Logistics in southern Lebanon relied on road convoys, temporary supply points, forward maintenance, and small dispersed transport units. Resolution 1701 authorized UNIFIL expansion to 15,000 personnel. Casualty estimates varied substantially between sources, so no single total is treated here as a definitive figure.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是2006年7月19日的邊境事件與以軍進入黎境，但它建立在更長期的安全衝突上。以色列在1978年入侵黎巴嫩、1982年再次出兵，2000年撤出後，邊境位置、謝巴農場與藍線的解釋一直存在爭議。此後真主黨在黎南部署火箭砲和反裝甲力量，向以色列北部發動跨境射擊；以色列則以空襲、偵察和邊界行動打擊相關陣地。2006年春季以後，邊境巡邏、真主黨進入以軍控制的狹窄地帶，以及以軍準備進入黎北的計畫，使局勢持續升溫。安理會第1696號決議已把撤出黎南與歸還兩名被扣以軍士兵列為要求，但各方沒有完全接受並執行。7月19日事件後，以色列宣稱行動是為了阻止士兵被擄走並摧毀火箭發射陣地；真主黨則稱以軍越界入侵，要求以色列撤出。被扣士兵、邊境線、反裝甲陣地與火箭襲擊在同一時間交會，因而迅速擴大為全面戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the border incident of 19 July 2006 and the Israeli entry into Lebanon, but the war rested on a longer security conflict. Israel had invaded Lebanon in 1978 and again in 1982, and after its 2000 withdrawal the interpretation of the border, the Sheba Farms area, and the Blue Line remained disputed. Hezbollah subsequently established rocket and anti-tank positions in southern Lebanon and fired rockets into northern Israel, while Israel responded with airstrikes, reconnaissance, and operations along the border. Tensions rose further during the spring of 2006 through border patrols, Hezbollah movement into a narrow area controlled by the Israeli military, and Israeli preparations for a possible operation in northern Lebanon. Resolution 1696 had already called for a Hezbollah withdrawal from southern Lebanon and the return of two detained Israeli soldiers, but the parties did not fully accept or implement it. After 19 July, Israel stated that its operation was intended to prevent the abduction of soldiers and destroy rocket-launching positions. Hezbollah described the Israeli movement as an incursion and demanded withdrawal. The detained soldiers, the border line, anti-tank positions, and rocket attacks converged at the same time, turning a limited confrontation into a full war.
impact: 軍事上，以色列的空襲與炮兵火力破壞或迫使真主黨移動部分雷達、通信節點、指揮建築、火箭發射點與南部後勤設施；馬龍拉斯等地的地面戰使若干反裝甲陣地和道路控制權短暫改變，但真主黨的南部作戰單位仍能重組並維持射擊。以軍在黎南的推進迫使對方把發射器材分散到更深或不同陣地，火箭砲仍能越過邊境射向北以色列，造成空襲警報與局部交通中斷。貝魯特的港口、機場、橋樑、道路和通信節點受到打擊或運作干擾。停火後，以軍退回藍線以南的既有邊界部署，黎巴嫩軍與擴編的聯合國部隊進入南部，但控制權並未完全統一。第1701號決議建立了新的停火框架，卻沒有完成真主黨全面解除武裝，也沒有解決所有邊境與安全爭議。
impactEn: militarily, Israeli air and artillery operations damaged or forced the relocation of some radar, communications nodes, command buildings, rocket launchers, and southern Lebanese logistics facilities. The fighting around Maroun al-Ras temporarily changed control of some anti-tank positions and roads, but Hezbollah's southern formations could reorganize and continue firing. The Israeli advance into southern Lebanon pushed launchers deeper or into different positions, yet the rockets still crossed the border and fired toward northern Israel, producing air-raid alerts and localized transportation disruptions. Beirut's port, airport, bridges, roads, and communications nodes were struck or operationally disrupted. After the ceasefire, Israeli forces returned to positions behind the Blue Line, while the Lebanese Armed Forces and expanded UNIFIL presence entered the south, although control was not fully unified. Resolution 1701 created a new ceasefire framework, but it did not complete Hezbollah's disarmament or settle every border and security dispute.
result: 停火在8月11日凌晨約兩時開始生效，部分地段仍出現零星交火。以色列在9月初完成了大部分從黎巴嫩新增陣地的撤離，海上封鎖也隨之放鬆；因此，以色列達成了退出此次大規模地面進攻、降低部分前沿威脅的軍事目標，但沒有消滅真主黨的北部火箭與反裝甲能力。8月4日真主黨攻勢沒有突破以軍主要防線，卻迫使以軍延長地面作戰並最終撤出，顯示其部隊仍具備縱深打擊與地面協同能力。停火後，黎巴嫩軍和聯南部隊分擔南部任務，聯合國觀察安排擴大；然而真主黨軍事組織與武器未被全面解除，藍線仍是主要軍事分界，南部控制權也不完整。這場戰爭以停火而非完整和平協議結束，邊境安排、解除武裝與長期安全責任都留給後續聯合國與黎巴嫩政治程序處理。
resultEn: The ceasefire took effect at about 02:00 on 11 August, although isolated exchanges continued in some sectors. Israel completed the withdrawal from most of its newly established positions in Lebanon by early September, and the naval blockade was relaxed. Israel therefore achieved its immediate military objective of ending the large-scale ground incursion and reducing some forward threats, but it did not eliminate Hezbollah's northern rocket and anti-tank capabilities. Hezbollah's 4 August offensive did not break the main Israeli defensive line, yet it prolonged Israeli ground operations and contributed to the eventual withdrawal, showing that Hezbollah retained the ability to conduct deep strikes and combined-arms attacks. After the ceasefire, the Lebanese Armed Forces and UNIFIL assumed parts of the southern mission, and the United Nations presence expanded. Hezbollah's military organization and weapons were not comprehensively disarmed, the Blue Line remained the principal military dividing line, and control in southern Lebanon was incomplete. The war ended in a ceasefire rather than a comprehensive peace agreement, leaving border arrangements, disarmament, and long-term security responsibilities to later United Nations and Lebanese political processes.
